hook: Over 2,000 people in South Africa recreated a state funeral from 1926.

sections.voiceover: Over 2,000 people in South Africa recreated a state funeral from 1926.

sections.voiceover: Mourners gathered at the National Women's Monument in Bloemfontein. Girls from Eunice and Oranje schools led the procession in white. Why did thousands honour this Cornish native?
sections.visual_cue: Wide pan of the National Women's Monument in Bloemfontein, followed by schoolgirls marching with palm fronds.
b_roll: National Women's Monument Bloemfontein drone view
Eunice and Oranje schoolgirls marching procession

sections.voiceover: But she'd died at age 66 in a flat at Bedford Gardens House in Kensington, London.
sections.visual_cue: Vintage photograph of Bedford Gardens House in Kensington, London.
b_roll: Bedford Gardens House historical building facade

sections.voiceover: Over 2,000 people joined the Emily100 commemoration in South Africa. Two hundred schoolgirls carried palm fronds in memory of Emily Hobhouse. They recreated her 1926 state funeral.
sections.visual_cue: Large crowd participating in the Emily100 march led by 200 schoolgirls carrying palm fronds.
b_roll: Schoolgirls carrying palm fronds historic recreation

sections.voiceover: Her life ended at Bedford Gardens House on 8 June 1926.
sections.visual_cue: Archival portrait of Emily Hobhouse with text displaying her date of death.
